append_text_to_image: append lines of text underneath a numpy image array using OpenCV putText
overlay_frame: overlay flattened info dictionary values as text lines on a rendered frame image
HabRenderWrapper_init: create a HabRenderWrapper gym wrapper that overlays measure values on rendered frames
HabRenderWrapper_step: step the wrapped gym environment while tracking accumulated reward and step count
HabRenderWrapper_render: render the wrapped environment frame with overlaid step count and total reward text
